> FTP sends credentials and file contents in plaintext over two separate connections.

SFTP is a completely different protocol that runs inside a single SSH connection on port 22, encrypting everything and reusing SSH key authentication. FTPS is the third option: real FTP with TLS added, which keeps FTP's two-connection design and the firewall problems that come with it. For almost every situation, use SFTP.
